chain.title: Osmium Ingot
chain.desc: Osmium Ore generates at nearly every Y level and drops Raw Osmium; smelt it in a furnace. Osmium is the mod's starting metal.

chain.title: Metallurgic Infuser
chain.desc: Hand-crafted from 2 furnaces, 4 iron ingots, 2 redstone dust and 1 Osmium Ingot; the only Mekanism machine you can build before having steel.

chain.title: Basic Control Circuit
chain.desc: Infuse an Osmium Ingot with 20 units of Redstone in the Metallurgic Infuser. Circuits are the tier currency of every later machine recipe.

chain.title: Infused Alloy
chain.desc: Infuse an iron ingot with 10 units of Redstone in the Metallurgic Infuser; tier 2 of the four alloy tiers (plain redstone is tier 1).

chain.title: Steel Ingot
chain.desc: Infuse iron with Carbon (coal or charcoal dust) for Enriched Iron, infuse that again with Carbon for Steel Dust, then smelt the dust.

chain.title: Steel Casing
chain.desc: 4 Steel Ingots, 4 glass and 1 Osmium Ingot. Almost every Mekanism machine is a Steel Casing wrapped in alloys and circuits.

chain.title: Enrichment Chamber
chain.desc: Steel Casing surrounded by 4 redstone, 2 Basic Control Circuits and 2 iron. Turns 1 ore into 2 dust: the first ore-processing tier.

chain.title: Energized Smelter
chain.desc: Steel Casing with 4 redstone, 2 Basic Control Circuits and 2 glass. Smelts on machine power, so it pairs with the Enrichment Chamber for a full 2x ore line.

chain.title: Crusher
chain.desc: Steel Casing with 4 redstone, 2 Basic Control Circuits and 2 lava buckets. Grinds ingots to dust and clumps to dirty dust, closing the higher ore-processing loops.

chain.title: Basic Energy Cube
chain.desc: Steel Casing with 4 redstone, 2 Energy Tablets and 2 iron. Buffers generator output so machines keep running; Energy Tablets need Infused Alloy, gold and redstone.

chain.title: Electrolytic Separator
chain.desc: Built around an Electrolytic Core with 4 iron, 2 redstone and 2 Infused Alloy. Splits water into Hydrogen and Oxygen, the gases the next ore tiers run on.

chain.title: Purification Chamber
chain.desc: An Enrichment Chamber ringed with 4 Infused Alloy, 2 Advanced Control Circuits and 2 Osmium Ingots. Feeds on Oxygen to turn 1 ore into 3 clumps (3x ore).

chain.title: Reinforced Alloy
chain.desc: Infuse an Infused Alloy with 20 units of Diamond in the Metallurgic Infuser. Gates Elite Control Circuits and every 4x-tier machine.

chain.title: Chemical Injection Chamber
chain.desc: A Purification Chamber ringed with 4 Reinforced Alloy, 2 Elite Control Circuits and 2 gold. Injects Hydrogen Chloride to turn 1 ore into 4 shards (4x ore).

chain.title: Atomic Alloy
chain.desc: Infuse a Reinforced Alloy with 40 units of Refined Obsidian in the Metallurgic Infuser; Refined Obsidian Dust comes from infusing obsidian dust with Diamond.

chain.title: Chemical Dissolution Chamber
chain.desc: Steel Casing with 4 Refined Obsidian Ingots, 2 Basic Chemical Tanks and 2 Ultimate Control Circuits. Dissolves ore in Sulfuric Acid into Dirty Slurry, which a Chemical Washer and Chemical Crystallizer turn into Crystals for the full 5x ore yield.

chain.title: Digital Miner
chain.desc: Steel Casing with 2 Atomic Alloy, a Basic Control Circuit, 2 Logistical Sorters, a Robit and 2 Teleportation Cores. Filter-mines a whole chunk radius automatically.

chain.title: Atomic Disassembler
chain.desc: 4 Infused Alloy, an Energy Tablet, an Atomic Alloy and a Refined Obsidian Ingot. Powered all-purpose tool and the base item of the Meka-Tool.

chain.title: Pressurized Reaction Chamber
chain.desc: An Enrichment Chamber with a Dynamic Tank, 2 Basic Chemical Tanks, 2 Basic Control Circuits, 2 steel and an Infused Alloy. Combines item, fluid and gas inputs.

chain.title: HDPE Sheet
chain.desc: Bio Fuel plus water and Hydrogen in the Reaction Chamber makes Substrate, then Substrate plus Ethene and Oxygen makes HDPE Pellets; enrich 3 pellets into a sheet.

chain.title: Polonium Pellet
chain.desc: Run Nuclear Waste through a Solar Neutron Activator for Polonium gas, then react Polonium with Fluorite Dust and water in the Reaction Chamber.

chain.title: Meka-Tool
chain.desc: Atomic Disassembler and a Configurator with 2 HDPE Sheets, 2 Ultimate Control Circuits, 2 Polonium Pellets and a Basic Induction Cell; upgraded at a Modification Station.

chain.title: MekaSuit Bodyarmor
chain.desc: A netherite chestplate with 4 HDPE Sheets, an Ultimate Control Circuit, 2 Polonium Pellets and a Basic Induction Cell. Modules slot in at a Modification Station.

chain.title: Antiprotonic Nucleosynthesizer
chain.desc: Steel Casing with 4 Atomic Alloy, 2 Ultimate Control Circuits and 2 Antimatter Pellets; antimatter is produced by the SPS multiblock from Polonium.

notes: All 24 ids were checked against Mekanism-1.20.1-10.4.16.80.jar (Modrinth, Forge/NeoForge 1.20.1); item ids were taken from assets/mekanism/models/item/*.json unioned with item./block. keys in assets/mekanism/lang/en_us.json (415 unique paths). Descriptions were derived from the jar's own data/mekanism/recipes/*.json, so ingredient counts are exact. IMPORTANT CROSS-MOD DEPENDENCY: base Mekanism has no generators. Practical power (Heat Generator, Gas-Burning Generator, Fission and Fusion Reactors) lives in Mekanism: Generators (modid mekanismgenerators), and the Nuclear Waste that gates the Polonium Pellet / Meka-Tool / MekaSuit / Antiprotonic Nucleosynthesizer entries is a Fission Reactor output. If Mekanism: Generators is not in the pack, the last four entries are unreachable without another waste source. Wiki-named things deliberately NOT included because they are not mekanism: items in this jar: Heat Generator, Gas-Burning Generator, Fission Reactor Casing, Fusion Reactor, Turbine and Wind Generator (all mekanismgenerators), and Paxel/armor tiers (mekanismtools). The SPS is represented by the Antiprotonic Nucleosynthesizer rather than mekanism:sps_casing so the chain ends on a machine; mekanism:sps_casing, mekanism:sps_port, mekanism:pellet_antimatter and mekanism:pellet_plutonium all exist in the jar if the integrator wants extra endgame steps. Other verified ids worth using as optional side quests: mekanism:teleportation_core, mekanism:teleporter, mekanism:quantum_entangloporter, mekanism:qio_drive_array, mekanism:thermal_evaporation_controller, mekanism:solar_neutron_activator, mekanism:isotopic_centrifuge, mekanism:modification_station, mekanism:jetpack, mekanism:free_runners, mekanism:robit, mekanism:basic_induction_cell, mekanism:induction_casing, mekanism:chemical_washer, mekanism:chemical_crystallizer (the two 5x-tier machines folded into the Dissolution Chamber entry). Only two entities exist (entity.mekanism.robit, entity.mekanism.flame) and the mod adds no dimensions, so no kill: or dim: steps apply.
